question: exllamav3 autosplit across R9700 (gfx1201) + Strix Halo iGPU (gfx1151), GLM-5.3 EXL3, round 2 (2026-10-10, amd_iommu=off)
status: BLOCKED at torch kernel level, one layer below the known BLAS mixing problem
root_cause: The kyojin venv torch wheel 2.12.0a0+rocm7.13.0a20260411 is compiled for gfx1151 ONLY: torch.cuda.get_arch_list() == ['gfx1151']. Any aten op (even torch.randn / elementwise add, no BLAS involved) on the R9700 fails with hipErrorInvalidImage (device kernel image is invalid). The 353 copied 7.2.1 gfx1201 Tensile/rocBLAS/hipBLASLt files are irrelevant to this failure and, per glm-exl3-autosplit-blocker.json round 1, additionally break hipblasSgemm with HIPBLAS_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR (version-incompatible API mix).

evidence.env: cd /root/kyojin; EXL3_HSA_LIB=<venv _rocm_sdk_devel>/lib/libhsa-runtime64.so.1; source tools/strix_halo/env.sh; no HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES
evidence.device_order: cuda:0 = AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201), cuda:1 = Radeon 8060S Graphics (gfx1151) in unfiltered processes; single-device serve works because serve_kyojin_glm.sh pins HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
evidence.igpu_sole: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1: torch.randn 512x512 + matmul + sync OK on gfx1151 (5632.19)
evidence.r9700: any torch op on gfx1201: torch.AcceleratorError: CUDA error: device kernel image is invalid (hipErrorInvalidImage) - fails on randn alone, BLAS never reached
evidence.system_rocm: amd_iommu=off active; rocminfo lists both agents (gfx1151, gfx1201); /opt/rocm 7.2.1 HSA (1.18.70201) lacks the ROCR_1-versioned hsa_ext_image_create_v2 symbol the 7.13 wheel libamdhip64.so.7 needs, so LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm/lib cannot be used at all (undefined symbol at torch import)
evidence.wheel_arch_list: torch.cuda.get_arch_list() == ['gfx1151']; libtorch_hip.so strings do contain gfx1200/gfx1201 symbols but the shipped device kernels are gfx1151-only, and aten fails on gfx1201 regardless of the copied 7.2.1 Tensile libs
evidence.prior_probes: /root/bench/autosplit-v4.out shows the same load failing later at touch_device hipblasSgemm HIPBLAS_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR (BLAS mixing layer) once the missing-file Tensile errors were patched
